rationale: Evolve is the same issuer as its Constellation and Sanchez predecessors and remains an operating Stonepeak-controlled U.S. midstream platform. Stonepeak entered through private preferred equity in 2015, acquired general-partner control on September 7, 2020, and eliminated the unaffiliated public float on February 16, 2024. Current manager evidence supports continued ownership, while the repository materially misstates the security, ownership chronology, financing amount, public status and asset perimeter.
recommendedChanges: Retain one canonical Evolve Transition Infrastructure LP company and add its Constellation, Sanchez Production Partners and Sanchez Midstream Partners predecessor names as aliases.
Record Stonepeak's 2015 preferred investment as investment history, September 7, 2020 as the qualifying control date, and February 16, 2024 as the date it obtained all remaining economic interests.
Preserve Constellation/Exelon, the Sanchez sponsor group and unaffiliated public unitholders as former ownership or control history.
Correct Evolve from publicly traded to private/deregistered and retain Catarina and Seco as its current disclosed operating perimeter.
Remove Carnero, HOBO and Levo from the current perimeter; keep them as former or unconsummated asset/JV history rather than separate PortCos.
Correct the 2015 record to distinguish the $350 million preferred financing from the separate approximately $345.8 million Catarina asset acquisition.
unresolvedQuestions: Post-Form-15 Class C preferred and warrant mechanics are not publicly disclosed.
Current 2026 throughput, Mesquite contract status and Seco utilization are not publicly disclosed.
Any residual Sanchez upper-vehicle interest after the 2020 GP transfer is not publicly disclosed.
